report: Independent experience audit: live mastery omits gold/time conditions used by settlement; player cannot plan all three-star requirements.

scope.rationale: Core reward rule and default HUD presentation must agree; retain natural and independent perceptual retest.

steps: Compare live mastery rendering with starTargets/settle conditions
Verify menu and settlement use numeric challenge text
Capture current replay with complete visible challenge progress
observed: Live mastery displays catch/jump/no-hit but omits required gold and time

acceptanceCriteria: Display actual fish, gold, jump, no-hit and time targets consistently
No overflow or head/road occlusion on four mobile sizes
Natural 2/3-star settlement and replay reflect the conditions
